To create a palindrome, we start with any phrase or sentence and then reverse the order of the letters in the second half of the phrase to make it match the first half. The middle character (if there is an odd number of characters) remains the same.

So, the process is:

1. Choose a phrase or sentence
2. Reverse the order of the letters in the second half
3. Add the reversed second half to the beginning
